title: Quenched Silky Slovakian Ladyfingers Trifle
description: A rich and energizing Slovakian dessert featuring savoiardi ladyfingers, made in a cataplana vessel and served in a stone bowl, providing a unique and silky texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter and egg yolks until well combined.
Add the cocoa powder to the egg yolk mixture and whisk until smooth.
Dip each ladyfinger into the egg yolk mixture for about 3 seconds on each side.
In a cataplana vessel, create a layer of ladyfingers, followed by a layer of the whipped cream mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
Refrigerate the trifle for at least 3 hours to allow the flavors to meld together.
Just before serving, sprinkle the top of the trifle with chopped nuts if desired.
Serve the trifle chilled, garnished with additional whipped cream if desired.
